column7: C-GUARD-3 registry test: every storage function that inserts or un-deletes a child of a soft-deletable parent must re-check the parent under lockLiveParent in the same transaction, or be in docs/child-parent-liveness-exempt.tsv with a reason. New child models are caught by TestChildParentLiveness_EveryIDFieldClassified. Found by ISSUE-TRIAGE-1 (2026-10-17).
